entries.04208ab92aa70575: This category is not included in the reportable segments and consists of real estate leasing conducted by its consolidated subsidiary Isamu Tochi Tatemono Co., Ltd. Within the group, non-consolidated subsidiary Isamu Motor Pool Co., Ltd. also operates parking facilities. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥102 million.
entries.081e45367bed37fe: A paint manufacturer in Osaka that makes and sells paints, mainly for automotive refinishing, as well as for industrial and architectural use.
entries.0972493444e31183: This is the business in which Isamu Motor Pool Co., Ltd. operates parking facilities. Amounts within this category are not disclosed.
entries.2afdd46e712ebda4: Customers in the construction and painting field
entries.6d7d098cd46546be: This is a reportable segment that manufactures and sells paints and thinners for automotive refinishing, industrial use, architectural use and other applications. The company manufactures and sells various paints, and its consolidated subsidiaries process semi-finished products, fill and repackage products, and purchase and sell related merchandise. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥8,300 million. Disclosure of revenue by product and service is omitted because the Paint Business accounts for more than 90% of consolidated revenue, and amounts by field are not printed.
entries.8b20d60d31133136: Customers in the heavy vehicle field
entries.aa5aa0f234e1d25a: This is the field of paints used for automotive refinishing, specializing in the maintenance sector. The product lineup includes the one-component base coat “Hiart Next,” which complies with the Specified Chemical Substances Ordinance and the PRTR Act, and the water-based one-component base coats “Aquas DRY” and “CRONOS HD,” among others. Revenue by field is not disclosed.
entries.b0063864d232e0e0: This is the field of paints for industrial products, where sales activities are promoted through customized responses for each user. The product lineup includes the environmentally friendly two-component urethane resin paint “Hiart CB Eco” and the water-based one-component acrylic resin paint “Aqua Shine GA,” among others. Revenue by field is not disclosed.
entries.b9cd146a8736a9b8: This is the field of paints for building painting, centered on maintenance and also covering new construction. The main products include the “Neosilica” series, the interior photocatalytic paint “Air Fresh,” and the anti-slip paint “Skid Guard” series, among others. Revenue by field is not disclosed.
entries.d2562300b03494d6: This is the field in which the company manufactures stock solutions and sells them to its consolidated subsidiary Isamu Aerosol Kōgyō Co., Ltd., which manufactures aerosol products. The products handled include the repair spray “Air Lacquer Eco” and the DIY two-component internal-mixing aerosol spray “Air Urethane.” Revenue by field is not disclosed.
entries.d5dc9590f803551f: This is the business in which Isamu Tochi Tatemono Co., Ltd. conducts rental management and operation of rental properties in Kita Ward, Osaka City. Amounts within this category are not disclosed.
